correctness.rationale: Diagonal Hessian normalization yields C=[[1,c],[c,1]], 0<=c<1, and exact overrelaxed coordinate maps U,V. Direct matrix pullbacks for the two permutations versus four replacement pairs give generalized modal difference ω²(1-c²)(2-ω)/4 times [2-ω(1+c)] on symmetric C-energy and [2-ω(1-c)] on antisymmetric C-energy. The latter coefficient is always positive on 0<ω<2. Thus uniform strict P-over-R preference holds iff ω<2/(1+c), becomes nonstrict on one mode at equality, and preferences reverse by mode above it for c>0. Independent symbolic expansion recovers the factors and exact worst-case example at c=1/2,ω=19/10: P worst-case 137143/160000 > R worst-case 53949/64000. The one-coordinate decrement -ω(2-ω)[(Cy)_i]^2/2 is nonpositive. Results are one epoch only.
